name: sc-gamedata
description: Query layer (vendored by SCMCP) and combat export for sc-gamedata. The datasets are written by the Rust crate in crates/sc-gamedata.

scripts.export: node scripts/export-infographic.mjs --data "${DATA:-data}" && uv run -q --with openpyxl python scripts/csv-to-xlsx.py "exports/$(node -p "require(require('path').resolve(process.env.DATA || 'data', 'game-weapons.json'))._build")"
